rationale.text: A page with an XHTML 1.0 doctype, served as text/html, whose html element carries lang but not xml:lang. The test line reads lang and/or xml:lang, while the methodology and the glossary ask for both on XHTML 1.0 served as text/html; the official text does not settle which reading applies. The custom check answers cannot_tell when the attribute present is not the one the document type requires (step 2); only the record supports this branch. axe's html-has-lang finds a lang attribute and reports no fault, so the reason at full is cannot_tell; at fail_only, needs_review, not_enabled.

citations.quote: L’indication de la langue de la page (attribut `lang` et/ou `xml:lang`) est donnée pour l’élément `html`
Soit au moyen des attributs lang et xml:lang sur la balise html si le code est du XHTML 1.0 ;
Pour XHTML 1.0 servi en "text/html" : attribut lang et xml:lang obligatoires ;
